shortDescription: CLAT Admission Online Form 2026 – Consortium of NLUs CLAT applications open 3 Aug to 31 Oct 2026 at consortiumofnlus.ac.in. Exam on 6 Dec 2026 for UG & PG law admission.
content:
Consortium of National Law Universities (NLUs) conducts the Common Law Admission Test (CLAT) for admission to undergraduate and postgraduate law programmes at NLUs across India.

As per the official calendar, the next application window opens in August 2026 for the CLAT cycle with exam in December 2026 (officially labelled CLAT 2027 on the Consortium portal).

Important Dates

  • Applications open: 03 August 2026
  • Last date to apply: 31 October 2026
  • Exam date: 06 December 2026
  • Admit card / result: As per Consortium notices

Courses

  • CLAT UG: 5-year integrated law programmes (BA LL.B., BBA LL.B., etc.) at NLUs
  • CLAT PG: One-year LL.M. programmes at participating NLUs

Eligibility (summary)

UG: Passed or appearing in 10+2 or equivalent with minimum percentage as prescribed in the official notification (category-wise).

PG: LL.B. degree or equivalent with minimum marks as prescribed; final-year students may apply as per rules.

Application Fee (indicative – verify on portal)

  • General / OBC / PwD / other non-SC/ST: about ₹4,000
  • SC / ST: about ₹3,500

How to Apply

  1. Open https://consortiumofnlus.ac.in
  2. Register for CLAT and complete the online form
  3. Upload photograph and signature, select test centres, pay fee and submit
  4. Save the confirmation page for admit card and counselling login

Apply only on the official Consortium website. NLU preference filling and counselling details are published separately after the result as per official notifications.
